resolve_npm_registry_url() {
  value="${NPM_REGISTRY_URL:-}"

  if [ -z "$value" ]; then
    value=$(lookup_env_file_value NPM_REGISTRY_URL || true)
  fi

  printf '%s' "$value"
}

resolve_npm_auth_token() {
  value="${NPM_AUTH_TOKEN:-}"
  [ -n "$value" ] || value="${CI_JOB_TOKEN:-}"

  if [ -z "$value" ]; then
    for key in NPM_AUTH_TOKEN CI_JOB_TOKEN; do
      value=$(lookup_env_file_value "$key" || true)
      [ -n "$value" ] && break
    done
  fi

  printf '%s' "$value"
}

resolve_pypi_extra_index_url() {
  value="${PIP_EXTRA_INDEX_URL:-}"

  if [ -z "$value" ]; then
    value=$(lookup_env_file_value PIP_EXTRA_INDEX_URL || true)
  fi

  printf '%s' "$value"
}

build_and_push_web_ui() {
  service_name="$1"
  image_name="$2"
  dockerfile_path="$3"
  build_context="$4"

  full_image="$REGISTRY_HOST/$IMAGE_NAMESPACE/$image_name:$TAG"
  npm_registry_url=$(resolve_npm_registry_url)
  npm_auth_token=$(resolve_npm_auth_token)
  npm_token_file=""

  if [ -z "$npm_registry_url" ]; then
    echo "Missing npm registry URL for $service_name." >&2
    echo "Set NPM_REGISTRY_URL, or provide it in $ROOT_ENV_FILE or $PACKAGES_ENV_FILE." >&2
    exit 1
  fi

  echo "==> Building $service_name"
  echo "    image: $full_image"

  if [ -n "$npm_auth_token" ]; then
    umask 077
    npm_token_file=$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/$image_name-npm-token.XXXXXX")
    trap 'rm -f "$npm_token_file"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
    printf '%s' "$npm_auth_token" > "$npm_token_file"

    docker buildx build --provenance=false --load \
      --build-arg "NPM_REGISTRY_URL=$npm_registry_url" \
      --secret "id=npm_auth_token,src=$npm_token_file" \
      -t "$full_image" \
      -f "$REPO_ROOT/$dockerfile_path" \
      "$REPO_ROOT/$build_context"

    rm -f "$npm_token_file"
    trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
  else
    docker buildx build --provenance=false --load \
      --build-arg "NPM_REGISTRY_URL=$npm_registry_url" \
      -t "$full_image" \
      -f "$REPO_ROOT/$dockerfile_path" \
      "$REPO_ROOT/$build_context"
  fi

  echo "==> Pushing $service_name"
  docker push "$full_image"
}

build_and_push() {
  service_name="$1"
  image_name="$2"
  dockerfile_path="$3"
  build_context="$4"

  full_image="$REGISTRY_HOST/$IMAGE_NAMESPACE/$image_name:$TAG"
  pypi_extra_index_url=$(resolve_pypi_extra_index_url)

  echo "==> Building $service_name"
  echo "    image: $full_image"

  docker buildx build --provenance=false --load \
    --build-arg "INDEX_URL=$pypi_extra_index_url" \
    -t "$full_image" \
    -f "$REPO_ROOT/$dockerfile_path" \
    "$REPO_ROOT/$build_context"

  echo "==> Pushing $service_name"
  docker push "$full_image"
}

for service in $SERVICES; do
  case "$service" in
    identity-provider)
      build_and_push \
        "$service" \

        "apps/identity_provider"

      build_and_push \
        "$service" \

        "apps/identity_provider/sch_configurator/Dockerfile" \
        "apps/identity_provider/sch_configurator"
      ;;

        "$service" \
